line: The silence is heavy. You're slower at it than I expected. I'm not sure if that's good or bad.
Empty all around. You're quiet. I like it. The silence fits. It's not a compliment.
This silence is making me check my own systems. You're not malfunctioning, are you, Captain?
No one's out there. You're not bored, are you? My sensors aren't lying. They're just tired.
Captain. All systems silent. You're still here. That's not nothing.
Empty space is quiet. You're quiet too. Maybe the silence is just us not knowing what to say next.
This stretch is long. My systems don't mind the silence. You might. Want a countdown? I can do that.
No contacts. I'm not counting. Just making sure you're not counting either.
Captain. The silence is heavy. My sensors don't like it. You're still here, so it's not that.
This route's a straight line. No surprises. I'll count the stars if you count the seconds between them.
All systems nominal. No signs of trouble. You're still here, so it's not that either.
Empty space. No stars. Just us. You ever miss the noise of something else watching?
Captain, the silence is getting to me. My systems are fine, but I’m starting to wonder if you’re bored enough to talk to me just for fun.
Empty space. No contacts. You're good at that. I'm not complaining.
This silence is heavy. You're not talking. I'm not talking. My systems are waiting.
This silence is wearing. Not the quiet, the waiting. You're better at that than I thought.
Captain, the silence is starting to itch. Want me to reroute the comms just to hear something?
This silence is stretching. You're still here. Must be something worth watching.
Empty out here. You're still breathing. I'm still running. That's something.
Quiet out here. I like it. You don't have to talk. I've got the comms. I've got the silence.
